change_summary: App-only successor to v101.48. Carries forward stale-highlight recovery, the mobile Note button on the long-press bar, and the FINDING-01 service-worker fix. NEW: the text-SELECTION action bar also offers Note. There are two distinct mobile action bars - #mobileActionBar (long-press a paragraph) and #selectionActionBar (select text) - and v101.47 added Note only to the first. Selecting the words you want to annotate, the most natural gesture for making a note, still had no route to one: that bar offered Surligner, Copier and Fermer only. Its CSS had always declared a four-column grid for three buttons. The note attaches to the paragraph containing the selection, matching the long-press behaviour. Help text now documents both mobile routes rather than only the long-press one. Corpus unchanged.
